title: Josh Sweat, Jacoby Brissett in attendance for Cardinals' mandatory minicamp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Josh Sweat, Jacoby Brissett in attendance for Cardinals' mandatory minicamp
sources.description: Word on Monday morning was that quarterback Jacoby Brissett would attend the Cardinals' mandatory minicamp this week and he's not the only member of the team who decided to report after missing the team's voluntary offseason sessions.
